g high school seniors. We know that many are eager to begin their college admissions process, and we hope that what follows is helpful as you plan and prepare to submit an application to Wake Forest. Our application for admission will be available on August 1. We will accept the Common Application and the Coalition Application, Powered by SCOIR. Your experience will be the same, no matter which application you choose, and both applications are evaluated in the same manner. We would encourage you to familiarize yourself with our various application deadlines : November 15 for those applying via Early Decision or Early Action (for first-generation college students only); January 1 for those applying Early Decision II or Regular Decision. If you are interested in applying Early Decision, our virtual program on July 17 from 7-8 p.m. might be of interest!
